text: Eleanor Webb, a teenage vampire, writes her life story and scatters the pages to the wind, while her mother Clara [kills to keep them both hidden|wants|survival and self-defence]. Fleeing a secret brotherhood of vampires, they settle in a decaying seaside resort, where Clara turns the run-down Byzantium Hotel into a brothel. Eleanor falls for Frank, a dying young waiter, and her story reaches back two centuries to [the captain who raped them both|wrong|sexual violation] and to [the island where people become vampires|images|wild and lonely places].
